teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle jumps to No. 1 after beating Kansas City 20-3 at home. The defense is the engine at +2.4 points, while the offense sits at just +0.1. Chicago, ranked #7, visits next.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers stay at No. 2 even after a 29-20 loss at Atlanta. Their offense is still the best unit at +3.6 points, and the model rates them 2.8 points higher than the betting market does.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo had its bye and slid from No. 1 to No. 3 without playing. The offense is great at +4.7 points, the defense at -1.1 is the soft spot, and Baltimore comes to town as a 10.0-point underdog.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville rested and dropped one spot to No. 4. They're 4-2 with a 50-point differential and an 82 percent shot at the division. The Colts visit next.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams are 3-4 but rated fifth, helped by a 35-21 win at Las Vegas. The offense carries them at +2.5 points, and the Chargers are next, with the model favoring L.A. by 11.3.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit edged Green Bay 20-17 at home but still slipped a spot to No. 6. Next comes a home game against Minnesota, which the model gives them by 3.2.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago climbed two spots to No. 7 with a 30-24 win over New England. Now comes a trip to Seattle, where the model has the Bears as 4.8-point underdogs.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: The Chiefs fell to 8th after a 20-3 loss at Seattle. They're still 5-1 with a 59 percent chance at the division, and next they visit Denver, where the model sees a coin flip, slightly against them.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota is 6-0 and has won 6 straight, yet sits ninth because the offense is -2.0 points. The defense at +2.6 does the heavy lifting, and next up is a trip to Detroit.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England lost 30-24 at Chicago but held at No. 10, with injuries adding 1.7 points to their rating. Miami is next, and the model likes them by 6.1.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati beat Baltimore 35-13 on the road and gained 1.6 rating points while staying at No. 11. Tennessee is next, with the model favoring them by 12.1.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay vaulted nine spots to No. 12 on the strength of a 43-13 win at Carolina. They're only 2-5, but the rating gained 3.8 points, and the model rates them 3.6 points above the market.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay lost 20-17 at Detroit and slipped to No. 13. They're 4-3 with a point differential of -1, and Carolina visits next as a 4.9-point underdog.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver has won 3 straight, the latest a 30-16 win at Arizona, and sits 5-2 at No. 14. The Chiefs visit next, and the model leans to Denver by just 0.5.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas moved up three spots to No. 15 after a 38-21 win in Philadelphia. The offense is +2.2 points and the defense is -2.2. Arizona visits next.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta rose four spots to No. 16 by beating the 49ers 29-20. This week's starter puts them 2.3 points above their usual quarterback situation. Tampa Bay is next.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston lost 27-21 at home to the Giants and fell two spots to No. 17. They're 2-5, and the model rates them 2.4 points lower than the market does.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh has won 3 straight, the latest 16-10 over New Orleans, and is 5-2. The rating still sits at -0.2, and the offense at -0.7 is the weak spot. Cleveland visits next.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis has lost 3 straight, the latest a 16-10 loss at Minnesota. At 2-5 with a -26 point differential, they now travel to face Jacksonville as 7.7-point underdogs.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina fell seven spots to No. 20 after a 43-13 home loss to Tampa Bay. The scoring margin cost them 1.1 points, and next is a trip to Green Bay.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington used its bye week to drop four spots to No. 21. They're 1-4-1 with a -40 point differential, and the defense at -1.2 is the weakest unit. Philadelphia comes next.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore lost 35-13 at home to Cincinnati. This week's starter puts them 3.4 points below their usual quarterback situation, and the model rates them 3.5 points lower than the market.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants climbed nine spots to No. 23, the biggest gain in the group, after a 27-21 win at Houston. The quarterback situation added 1.8 points, and they're 4-2-1.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets lost 28-25 at home to Miami and stayed at No. 24. They're 2-5 with a -13 point differential, and the offense at -1.7 is the problem. Las Vegas is next.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona moved up four spots to No. 25 despite a 30-16 home loss to Denver. The point differential is -66, and the defense at -1.1 is the weakest unit. Dallas is next.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans lost 16-10 to Pittsburgh and stays at No. 26. They're 2-5 with a -32 point differential, and the offense at -1.5 is the weak spot. Next is week 9 against Cleveland.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland is 5-2 yet ranked 27th, because the offense is -2.6 points and the point differential is -13. They beat Tennessee 27-24 last time and visit Pittsburgh next.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas has lost 4 straight, the latest a 35-21 home loss to the Rams, and fell three spots to No. 28. The offense at -1.9 is the weak spot. The Jets are next.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-6 and have lost 6 straight, with a -61 point differential. They rested last week, and next they visit the Rams as 11.3-point underdogs.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami beat the Jets 28-25 on the road for its first win-column bump, and the offense gained 0.6 points. Still, they're 1-5 at No. 30, and New England visits next.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia fell eight spots to No. 31 after a 38-21 home loss to Dallas, its fifth straight. The quarterback situation cost them 4.3 points, and Washington is next.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee lost 27-24 at home to Cleveland and sits last at No. 32. They're 1-6, the offense is -3.1 points, and Cincinnati is next as a 12.1-point favorite.
